classificationRules.STRUCTURAL_OR_EXECUTION_FAILURE: Any authorization, input, execution, output, manifest, hash, or analysis invariant fails.
classificationRules.VROOM_REFERENCE_STABLE_AND_AGREES_WITH_A: All VROOM internal-stability gates and all frozen ALIS cross-method agreement gates pass.
classificationRules.PERSISTENT_METHOD_DISCREPANCY: All VROOM internal-stability gates pass but at least one frozen ALIS cross-method agreement gate fails.
classificationRules.VROOM_REFERENCE_STILL_UNDERCONVERGED: At least one VROOM internal-stability gate fails at 160 million photons per seed.
classificationRules.INCONCLUSIVE: A complete result cannot be assigned by an earlier rule without violating the frozen contract.
